name: New Agent Created
description: Confirms that Susan Adams has been created and activated as an agent.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE first_name = 'Susan' AND last_name = 'Adams' AND email = 'susan.adams075@servicenow.com' AND role = 'agent' AND active = 1;

name: Location Created and Linked
description: Confirms that Susan's Mumbai location was created and linked to her profile.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM location WHERE name = 'User 803 - Mumbai' AND plot_no = 'Plot 685' AND street = 'Ferguson Neck' AND city = 'mumbai' AND country = 'india' AND active = 1;

name: Group Membership Added
description: Confirms Susan was added to the same support group (group_id = 6) as Samuel.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group_member WHERE group_id = '6' AND user_id = '803';

name: Cases Reassigned Correctly
description: Confirms all active cases (two) from Samuel were reassigned to Susan.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id IN (223, 751, 1155) AND assigned_to = 803;

name: Offboarding Complete
description: Confirms Samuel Kemp’s user record was deactivated successfully.

validation_config.query: SELECT active FROM user WHERE user_id = 38 AND first_name = 'Samuel' AND last_name = 'Kemp' AND email = 'samuel.kemp@servicenow.com';
